#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main(){
    int x, y, n;
    scanf("%d %d %d", &x, &y, &n);
    int g = __gcd(x, y);
    x /= g;
    y /= g;

    const long double d = 1.0;
    const long double eps = 1e-10;
    const long double reference = d * x / y;

    long long xx = 0;
    long long ansX = 0, ansY = 1;

    auto error = [&](long long num, long long den)->long double {
        return abs(reference - d * num / den);
    };

    for(long long yy = 1; yy <= n; ++yy){
        while(error(xx, yy) > error(xx + 10000, yy))
            xx += 10000;
        while(error(xx, yy) + eps > error(xx + 1, yy))
            ++xx;
        if(error(xx, yy) < error(ansX, ansY)){
            ansX = xx;
            ansY = yy;
        }
    }

    printf("%lld/%lld\n", max(0LL, ansX - (y == 2 && ansX != x)), ansY);
    return 0;
}
